scope: Native global tool-response ranking, last-resort public source callsite, cache and mixed-edit correctness only. W26 and Phase 5 remain open.
sourceBoundary: Every accepted GREEN execution matches the full final packages/scripts manifest, including its own executed test. Each source-before/source-after pair is unchanged. Earlier differing-source green runs are retained but excluded. Negative controls separately capture original/mutant target hashes, log hashes, cmp and restored final bytes; their runner did not capture a whole-source manifest for each mutant. Complete green files run serially with one Bun process per file and --timeout 180000. Graph validation is not affected-shard execution.

algorithm.storage: Versioned AVL order-statistic tree in existing ID_NS.nativeScalar trie facts, keyed by history:tool-ranking:1; no sidecar or history-sized RAM ranking collection.
algorithm.order: Descending exact float64 score, then descending raw source ordinal, then descending block index. Preserve the old array tie order, raw call IDs, row label/owner and source blocks.
algorithm.policyKey: JSON.stringify(['tool-stub:1', model, activeTokenizationProvider, tokenizer-identity generation UUID]); tokenizer resolution errors propagate. New tokenizer object changes generation.
algorithm.warmHistory: Same ready revision without pending overlay returns unchanged group: 40 repeats measure no history again, add zero file bytes and no commit. A new revision or density/structural mutation can refill all surviving history. This is not incremental O(log n) per turn.
algorithm.append: Ordinary append measures only added response blocks when prior revision is ready. Mixed purge/pop plus toolRanking must rebuild; readiness alone cannot justify old rows/counts.
algorithm.rounds: Merge history and pending ordered cursors, keep threshold endpoints, reproject after each publication and preserve cumulative stubs over the pinned source. Empty-AI holes retain current source ordinal ownership after filtering.
algorithm.pending: Only score/position/saving facts enter the existing journal pending namespace. Pending content rows remain caller input and transformed output, never prematurely appended as durable history. Pending rows and blocks are copied for transformation. Overlay is rebuilt for supplied pending input; no fixed pending-size or aggregate overlay-storage cap is proved. Stale unreachable fact capacity is not closed.

metricScope.cold: Cold fill physical reads are counted separately from pin/snapshot setup and initial history construction. See NATIVE_TOOL_COST lines.
metricScope.query: Combined position lookup, top lookup and first-three ordered range, after snapshot acquisition. Node-call bound is asserted; physical reads are measured, not independently bounded. The no-entries observer rejects a history scan.
metricScope.bytes: Every observed ID node cache has a charged 65536-byte cap. ROW liveBytes excludes shared ID/meta facts. Full physical file, range payload, aggregate cache/pin and global live bytes were not measured by this ranking receipt.
metricScope.codec: Each current rank encodes four 16-byte node parts and a 4-byte position value, plus 20-byte header and 4-byte last-parent value per tree. 68*n+24 is logical current scalar payload, excluding keys, stale slots, trie frames, metadata and journal trailers; it is not a measured file/live-byte total.
metricScope.lifetime: 512-row actual sink backpressure samples rank nodes and output rows via WeakRef. Observed objects, not retained heap/string bytes. Original old-backend borrowed/copy/string ownership bounds remain separate.

coverageBoundaries.public: Complete native source callsite uses full candidate request projection and transformed pending. Complete native old-array oracle covers 3/64/65/512/5000/8192 rows, equal-score ties, repeated raw group IDs, cross-speaker blocks, pending order, full rows/tokens and durable mirrors. It uses an injected scorer, not every provider tokenizer.
coverageBoundaries.owners: 3/64/65/5000 native alternating source owners, empty-AI hole and multiple projection rounds. One held native snapshot keeps automatic storage compaction outside the no-operation-file observation. Separate copy/compaction/reopen tests exercise storage compaction.
coverageBoundaries.failures: Native projection-primary plus pin-cleanup identity, prepublication abort, core rank-fill failure at row 65 with old policy preserved and same-writer continuation. Existing old-backend sink row-65/cancellation/large payload and original native detached checkpoint contracts run separately; they are not mislabeled as new native ranked sink-failure cases.
coverageBoundaries.original: Original old-layout tool truncation 512/8192 bounds, borrowed/distinct-copy retention traps and greater-than-nine-MiB value are unchanged. Native detached-checkpoint complete file preserves all greater-than-nine-MiB bytes. #3919 unchanged readerLifetime/readerCleanup complete files run at final source.
